content.page_summary: Reference list excerpt focused on studies of high-sensitivity cardiac troponin assays and early rule-out/rule-in strategies for acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Items include diagnostic algorithm design, utility of absolute/relative troponin changes, comparisons of rule-out strategies, economic evaluations, and outcomes after MI.
